node.title: L1 M31 T64 quotient-prefix intercept fence
node.closure: algebraic construction plus exact finite-field replay
node.statement: In the pinned Mersenne-31 c=2048, (u,v)=(0,1) quotient profile for upstream's auxiliary 2^-100 list row, seven explicit 479-subsets of the 1022-point punctured quotient domain share the first 63 nonleading locator coefficients. Six are distinct deficiency-64 neighbors of one anchor, so d_64(A)>=6. Exact arithmetic gives 4 binom(479,64)binom(543,64)<p^32, refuting every coefficient-four pointwise rooted-shell inequality p^32(d_64-b)_+<=4H_64 with intercept b=3,4,5. This is a support-level route cut, not a 2^-128 Prize row: no received word, first-match survival, row-global U_Q, or intercept-six theorem is claimed.
